title: The Office Kitchen and Shared Spaces
short: Clean up after yourself, label and clear out your food, don't take what isn't yours, keep calls and smells modest, and refill what you empty.
trouble: Learners leave a dish "to soak" for days or use the last of the coffee without making more. In shared spaces, leave it as you would want to find it.

blocks.html: After meetings, the office kitchen, the break room, the copier and the shared fridge are where colleagues meet most often. These spaces belong to everyone, which means everyone takes care of them.
Clean up after yourself, label and clear out your food, don't take what isn't yours, keep calls and smells modest, and refill what you empty.

In a shared space, every small mess becomes someone else's job. A dish left "to soak" is a dish a colleague has to move; an empty coffee pot greets the next tired person. Labels and weekly clean-outs keep the fridge from turning into a mystery. Strong smells and loud calls reach everyone nearby. The rule is easy: leave it as you would want to find it.

cards.text: Leaving a pan "to soak" in the sink for days
cards.why: Someone else must move it to use the sink.

cards.text: Making a new pot after taking the last cup
Eating a lunch from the fridge that isn't yours
cards.why: Ask first, or bring your own.

cards.text: Labeling your food with your name and the date
Reheating strong-smelling fish in a small office
cards.why: Smells travel; save strong foods for home or eat outside.

blocks.title: The last of the coffee
blocks.q: Leo pours the last cup of coffee in the office kitchen. What should he do?
steps: The next person will find an empty pot.
He makes a fresh pot, or tells whoever handles it that the coffee is out.

blocks.title: Friday fridge
blocks.q: Every Friday, the office clears out the fridge. Rosa's container of soup has been there since Monday. What should she do?
steps: She takes it home or throws it out before the clean-out.
She labels future lunches with her name and the date.

say: I took the last cup, so I started a fresh pot.

blocks.cap: A small courtesy in a shared kitchen.

blocks.html: Leaving a dish "to soak" for days, or using the last of the coffee without making more. In shared spaces, leave it as you would want to find it. Quick check: could the next person use this space right now without cleaning up after you?
